column1: # Real novelfull pages, unedited, captured through the dev Worker
# capture_url is where the bytes came from; app_url is the URL the app uses.
# They differ on exactly three rows: novelfull.com's catalogue does not carry
# those short novels (they 404 there), so those came from novelfull.net, which
# serves the same application. Files prefixed "net-" were captured from .net.
# The columns after them were measured at capture time by a script that does
# NOT use this app's parser, so the tests cross-check rather than echo it.
